items.title: The Cost of Saying Hello: An Empirical Study of Handshake Overhead in AI Agent Communication Protocols
items.titleZh: 打招呼的成本：人工智能代理通信协议中握手开销的实证研究
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30151v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Every interaction between AI agents begins with a handshake: the initiating agent must locate its counterpart, learn what it can do, and establish a session before the first useful message can be sent. Surveys of agent communication protocols name handshake overhead as an efficiency criterion, yet none report measurements. This paper presents the first empirical, phase-decomposed benchmark of the handshake in three major agent protocols: MCP (in both its 2025 initialize and 2026 discover eras), A2A, and ACP. Using each protocol's official SDK, we instrument every request for round trips, per-phase latency, wire bytes, and token cost across cold-start, warm-repeat, capability-mismatch, and degraded-metadata scenarios (N=50 per cell, on loopback and under an emulated 50 ms RTT). Round-trip count dominates handshake cost. A legacy MCP handshake takes three round trips and 230 ms at 50 ms RTT; A2A needs one round trip and 61.0 ms. Round trips are not the whole bill: when an LLM reads the counterpart's metadata, handshake cost scales with the counterpart's capability inventory at 24-107 tokens per capability, so a 200-capability counterpart spends 11% of a 200k-token context window before the agent reads its own task. MCP's own 2026 revision cuts its handshake from three round trips to two and, with era pinning, to zero on warm reconnects, protocol evolution that corroborates the cost we measure. We release the full harness, raw data, and analysis at https://github.com/pvarshh/handshake-benchmark.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.30151v1 公告类型：新
摘要：人工智能代理之间的每次交互都以握手开始：发起代理必须找到其对应方，了解它可以做什么，并在发送第一个有用消息之前建立会话。对代理通信协议的调查将握手开销称为效率标准，但没有报告测量结果。本文提出了三个主要代理协议中握手的第一个经验性、阶段分解基准：MCP（在 2025 年初始化和 2026 年发现时代）、A2A 和 ACP。使用每个协议的官方 SDK，我们在冷启动、热重复、功能不匹配和降级元数据场景（每个单元 N=50，在环回上且在模拟 50 ms RTT 下）中检测每个请求的往返、每相延迟、线路字节和令牌成本。往返次数在握手成本中占主导地位。传统 MCP 握手需要 3 次往返，在 50 毫秒 RTT 时需要 230 毫秒； A2A 需要一个往返，61.0 ms。往返并不是全部费用：当 LLM 读取对方的元数据时，握手成本会随着对方的能力库存而变化，每个能力需要 24-107 个令牌，因此，在代理读取自己的任务之前，拥有 200 个能力的对方会花费 200k 令牌上下文窗口的 11%。 MCP 自己的 2026 年修订版将握手次数从 3 次往返减少到 2 次，并且通过时代固定，在热重新连接时减少到零，协议的演变证实了我们测量的成本。我们在 https://github.com/pvarshh/handshake-benchmark 发布了完整的工具、原始数据和分析。

items.title: MCP vs CLI for AI Agents: A Comparative Analysis of Tool Integration Strategies for Autonomous Systems
items.titleZh: 用于 AI 代理的 MCP 与 CLI：自治系统工具集成策略的比较分析
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30157v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: AI agents require interfaces to interact with external systems such as files, APIs, databases, and cloud services. Two competing paradigms have emerged: CLI (Command Line Interface), where agents execute shell commands directly, and MCP (Model Context Protocol), a structured JSON-RPC protocol providing governed, typed tool access. This paper presents a comparative analysis across 14 evaluation dimensions, supported by worked examples, security assessment against established compliance frameworks, and economic modeling. Our analysis indicates that CLI provides superior efficiency for single-user, local-only workflows, while MCP addresses requirements that CLI fundamentally cannot satisfy, including fine-grained access control, credential isolation, structured audit, and multi-tenant governance. We further examine how progressive disclosure techniques eliminate MCP's historical weakness (context window overhead), yielding token efficiency comparable to CLI while preserving its architectural benefits. A hybrid architecture is recommended for production systems. This analysis draws upon academic, government, and industry sources including NSA formal guidance (CSI U/OO/6030316-26), OWASP security standards, and economic modeling from BCG and Gartner.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.30157v1 公告类型：新
摘要：人工智能代理需要接口来与文件、API、数据库和云服务等外部系统进行交互。出现了两种相互竞争的范例：CLI（命令行界面），代理直接执行 shell 命令；MCP（模型上下文协议），一种结构化的 JSON-RPC 协议，提供受管理的、类型化的工具访问。本文提出了 14 个评估维度的比较分析，并辅以工作示例、针对已建立的合规框架的安全评估以及经济模型。我们的分析表明，CLI 为单用户、仅限本地的工作流程提供了卓越的效率，而 MCP 解决了 CLI 从根本上无法满足的要求，包括细粒度访问控制、凭证隔离、结构化审计和多租户治理。我们进一步研究渐进式披露技术如何消除 MCP 的历史弱点（上下文窗口开销），产生与 CLI 相当的代币效率，同时保留其架构优势。建议生产系统采用混合架构。该分析借鉴了学术、政府和行业资源，包括 NSA 正式指南 (CSI U/OO/6030316-26)、OWASP 安全标准以及 BCG 和 Gartner 的经济模型。

items.title: Accelerating Wildfire Hazard Mapping Across Canada with an AI Surrogate Modelling Framework
items.titleZh: 利用人工智能替代建模框架加速加拿大各地的野火灾害测绘
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30170v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Canada's increasing wildfire activity requires frequent national hazard mapping to guide proactive mitigation, including fuel management, land-use planning, infrastructure protection, and evacuation routing. However, process-based wildfire simulation frameworks (e.g., BurnP3 and BurnP3+) rely on computationally intensive Monte Carlo simulations to model burn probability, fire intensity, and rate of spread. These workflows can take days to weeks to process a single regional modelling unit. To overcome these computational bottlenecks, we present three contributions developed through collaboration between AI researchers and wildfire modelling experts: (a) a standardized framework for training, fine-tuning, and evaluating AI surrogate models against process-based wildfire simulators; (b) a multi-task deep learning surrogate trained on national-scale data to emulate burn probability, mean fire intensity, and mean rate of spread at a fraction of the computational cost (seconds); and (c) domain-specific metrics and counterfactual evaluation protocols to probe out-of-distribution generalization. Integrating geospatial data (fuel, terrain, ignition likelihood) and regional weather, our model approximates BurnP3+ simulation outputs, achieving strong performance across agreement, rank-correlation, error, and spatial-overlap metrics. It preserves downstream hazard classifications and produces physically plausible responses to expert-informed counterfactual interventions. On a representative region, the surrogate achieves 806-fold end-to-end CPU acceleration and uses 13% of BurnP3+'s host memory, facilitating rapid scenario analysis.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.30170v1 公告类型：新
摘要：加拿大不断增加的野火活动需要经常绘制全国灾害图，以指导主动缓解措施，包括燃料管理、土地使用规划、基础设施保护和疏散路线。然而，基于过程的野火模拟框架（例如 BurnP3 和 BurnP3+）依赖于计算密集型蒙特卡罗模拟来模拟燃烧概率、火灾强度和蔓延速度。这些工作流程可能需要几天到几周的时间来处理单个区域建模单元。为了克服这些计算瓶颈，我们提出了人工智能研究人员和野火建模专家合作开发的三项贡献：（a）针对基于流程的野火模拟器进行训练、微调和评估人工智能替代模型的标准化框架； (b) 一个多任务深度学习代理，接受全国范围的数据训练，以计算成本（秒）的一小部分来模拟燃烧概率、平均火灾强度和平均蔓延率； (c) 用于探索分布外泛化的特定领域指标和反事实评估协议。我们的模型集成了地理空间数据（燃料、地形、点火可能性）和区域天气，近似 BurnP3+ 模拟输出，在一致性、等级相关性、误差和空间重叠指标方面实现了出色的性能。它保留了下游的危险分类，并对专家知情的反事实干预措施产生物理上合理的反应。在代表性区域上，代理实现了 806 倍的端到端 CPU 加速，并使用 BurnP3+ 主机内存的 13%，有利于快速场景分析。

items.title: Neural Networks with Differentiable Belief-Function Layers
items.titleZh: 具有可微相信函数层的神经网络
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30173v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Yager's 1987 rule of combination $\boxplus$ was proposed on epistemic grounds: under high conflict, mass should be redistributed to ignorance rather than renormalised onto the class simplex. We observe that backpropagation needs the same rule: Dempster's normaliser $(1{-}\kappa)^{-1}$, where $\kappa$ is the conflict mass, puts a $(1{-}\kappa)^{-2}$ term in the gradient that diverges exactly when evidence sources disagree, while Yager's $\boxplus$ is bilinear and has no such term. Building on this, we construct a deep evidential pipeline in which every mass in the chain from heads to output is a valid Dempster--Shafer mass function, combined by Yager's rule. The output mass on the ignorance set, $m(\Theta)$, serves as the network's ``I do not know'' signal. The network is fit to hard labels and never sees an annotator distribution, yet $m(\Theta)$ orders human disagreement in two modalities, visual and linguistic. Dempster's rises too and ranks contested inputs about as well, but its normaliser divides the conflict out: Yager's vacuity is $9\times$ larger on the most contested CIFAR-10H images, so only Yager's is readable as an amount of ignorance without recalibration. For out-of-distribution detection it is competitive with strong single-pass baselines, while the clamped Dempster variant that scores higher becomes gradient-unstable once the clamp is removed.

摘要：耶格尔 1987 年的组合规则 $\boxplus$ 是基于认识论基础提出的：在高度冲突下，质量应该重新分配到无知，而不是重新规范化到类单纯形上。我们观察到反向传播需要相同的规则：Dempster 的归一化器 $(1{-}\kappa)^{-1}$（其中 $\kappa$ 是冲突质量）在梯度中放置一个 $(1{-}\kappa)^{-2}$ 项，当证据来源不一致时，该项会完全发散，而 Yager 的 $\boxplus$ 是双线性的，没有这样的项。在此基础上，我们构建了一个深度证据管道，其中从头到输出的链中的每个质量都是有效的 Dempster-Shafer 质量函数，并由 Yager 规则组合。无知集 $m(\Theta)$ 上的输出质量充当网络的“我不知道”信号。该网络适合硬标签，并且永远不会看到注释器分布，但 $m(\Theta)$ 以视觉和语言两种方式排序人类的分歧。 Dempster 也上升了，并对有争议的输入进行了排名，但它的标准化器将冲突分开：在最有争议的 CIFAR-10H 图像上，Yager 的真空度要大 9 倍，因此只有 Yager 的空白在没有重新校准的情况下可以被解读为一定程度的无知。对于分布外检测，它与强大的单通道基线具有竞争力，而得分较高的钳位 Dempster 变体一旦钳位被移除，就会变得梯度不稳定。

items.title: When Stable and Preferred Semantics Agree: A Path-Based Approach
items.titleZh: 当稳定和首选语义一致时：基于路径的方法
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30176v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We investigate structural conditions under which preferred and stable semantics agree in abstract argumentation frameworks. Our approach is based on suitably chosen sets of paths in the attack graph and binary relations induced by them. We establish a general path-based criterion for semantic agreement and instantiate it with several classes of paths, obtaining sufficient conditions expressed in terms of well-foundedness of the corresponding relations.
 The resulting conditions strictly generalize two principal structural criteria for preferred and stable agreement in the literature: Dung's limited controversiality condition and the SCC-symmetry condition. In particular, Dung's result is recovered as a special case by taking the relevant path set to be the set of even paths. We further introduce two infinite sequences of path sets, each yielding a family of agreement conditions. For the first sequence, a Collapse Theorem reduces the infinitely many associated well-foundedness conditions to three essentially distinct ones, whereas the second sequence gives rise to genuinely distinct conditions with no analogous collapse. Our results apply to both finite and infinite argumentation frameworks, admit simplified formulations in the finite case, and also yield sufficient conditions for the existence of stable extensions.

items.title: Feedback That Backfires in Games: Do LLM Players Repeat the Move They Just Watched Fail?
items.titleZh: 在游戏中适得其反的反馈：LLM 玩家会重复他们刚刚看到的失败举动吗？
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30205v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: When an LLM agent's move fails, the harness writes the move and the failure message into the transcript and asks again. In tool calling, this record makes small models more likely to repeat the failed action. We test whether the same holds in games (Sokoban, Connect Four, Othello), where a move can fail by being illegal or by being legal but losing, both verified exactly. On fixed probe items built by perturbing a correct move, the record backfires: pooled over 8 instruction-tuned models (135M-1.7B) it makes the failed move more likely (corrective gain G = -1.38 nats per token), through the move's surface form, for illegal moves but not for losing ones, and not for every model. An exploratory analysis shows what sets the sign: after the record, the failed move's log-probability barely depends on how likely it was before (slope 0.18). Moves the model would not have played become more likely, and greedy decoding starts to produce them; moves it was about to play become less likely, but greedy decoding still repeats 38% of them. A description of the failure that omits the move string keeps the model's preference instead. Along the OLMo 2 1B post-training ladder the inversion is present in the base model and largely removed at the DPO stage. RAGEN's default models invert in RAGEN's own Sokoban format before any RL. A "do not repeat" instruction does nothing, a clean retry is the worst harness, and a decoder ban stops exact repeats but not illegal play. All measurements ran in float32 on a free Colab GPU, which first reproduced the original paper's number.

摘要：当 LLM 代理的移动失败时，线束会将移动和失败消息写入记录中并再次询问。在工具调用中，此记录使得小模型更有可能重复失败的操作。我们测试了同样的情况在游戏（推箱子、四子棋、黑白棋）中是否成立，其中一步棋可能因非法或合法但失败而失败，这两种情况都得到了准确验证。在通过干扰正确的移动而构建的固定探针项目上，记录会适得其反：汇集超过 8 个指令调整模型 (135M-1.7B)，通过移动的表面形式，它使失败的移动更有可能发生（校正增益 G = -1.38 纳特/令牌），对于非法移动但不是对于失败的移动，并且不是对于每个模型。探索性分析显示了标志的设定：在记录之后，失败走势的对数概率几乎不取决于它之前的可能性（斜率 0.18）。模型本来不会下的动作变得更有可能，并且贪婪解码开始产生它们；它即将下的棋步变得不太可能，但贪婪解码仍然会重复其中的 38%。省略移动字符串的故障描述会保留模型的偏好。沿着 OLMo 2 1B 训练后阶梯，反演存在于基础模型中，并在 DPO 阶段大部分被删除。 RAGEN 的默认模型在任何 RL 之前以 RAGEN 自己的推箱子格式反转。 “不重复”指令不会执行任何操作，干净的重试是最糟糕的手段，而解码器禁令会阻止精确的重复，但不会阻止非法播放。所有测量均在免费的 Colab GPU 上以 float32 形式运行，该 GPU 首先重现了原始论文的数字。

items.title: Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop
items.titleZh: 通过人类-人工智能发现循环打破莱默问题的高度障碍
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30277v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: While artificial intelligence has made rapid progress in mathematical reasoning, many open problems depend on structure that is revealed only through large-scale computational exploration and analytical synthesis. One such example is Lehmer's problem from 1933. It asks whether the Mahler measure of an integer polynomial, which measures how far its roots stray from the unit circle, can be made arbitrarily small. Previously, constructing irreducible polynomials with integer coefficients and small Mahler measure has been carried out systematically only for even degrees $d \le 180$. At higher degrees, Boyd's analytical one-parameter family frequently factors, skipping nearly 50% of target degrees and leaving no general construction for arbitrary $d$. Here, we address the high-degree regime through a human-AI discovery loop, in which we extend the conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier, and large-scale distributed search. The AI agent prototypes numerical and symbolic solvers locally, launches parallel searches across distributed clusters and works with the human researcher to extract and verify mathematical hypotheses. Through this interactive loop, we derive a five-parameter construction, which we call the Generalized Boyd algorithm. It eliminates degree-skipping and constructs irreducible polynomials with Mahler measure strictly below Boyd's limit point $\alpha_1 \approx 1.255434$ for every target degree. Evaluated across all even degrees up to 2000, our approach improves upon six previously published values and holds 99.6% of all best known records. With this work we release the verified dataset of polynomials with minimal Mahler measure across all studied even degrees.

摘要：虽然人工智能在数学推理方面取得了快速进展，但许多开放问题依赖于只有通过大规模计算探索和分析综合才能揭示的结构。 1933 年的莱默问题就是这样一个例子。它询问整数多项式的马勒测度（衡量其根偏离单位圆的距离）是否可以任意小。以前，仅针对偶数次 $d \le 180$ 系统地构造具有整数系数和小马勒测度的不可约多项式。在更高的度数上，Boyd 的分析单参数族经常进行因子分解，跳过近 50% 的目标度数，并且没有为任意 $d$ 留下任何一般构造。在这里，我们通过人类-人工智能发现循环来解决高度制度，其中我们通过快速数字管道、精确符号验证器和大规模分布式搜索来扩展对话提示。人工智能代理在本地构建数值和符号求解器原型，跨分布式集群启动并行搜索，并与人类研究人员合作提取和验证数学假设。通过这个交互循环，我们得出了一个五参数构造，我们称之为广义博伊德算法。它消除了跳度，并为每个目标度数构造了马勒测度严格低于博伊德极限点 $\alpha_1 \approx 1.255434$ 的不可约多项式。我们的方法对截至 2000 年的所有偶数度进行了评估，改进了之前发布的 6 个值，并保留了所有最著名记录的 99.6%。通过这项工作，我们发布了经过验证的多项式数据集，在所有研究的偶数度中具有最小马勒测度。

items.title: Route-and-Generate: KL-Regularized Router Improvement for Reasoning Routing in LLMs
items.titleZh: 路由和生成：LLM 中推理路由的 KL 正则化路由器改进
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30351v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models often apply complex reasoning indiscriminately, leading to overthinking on simple tasks and underthinking on harder ones. We present Route-and-Generate (Rouge), a hierarchical training framework that enables LLMs to adaptively decide when and how much reasoning is required for each input. Our approach decouples reasoning effort allocation from answer generation by introducing a routing policy that allocates a fixed sampling budget across multiple reasoning formats, while the base model is optimized with GRPO using per-sample rewards. To promote efficient reasoning, we employ a rank-based reward that favors shorter correct solutions, and update the routing policy via a closed-form KL-regularized policy improvement step distilled into a neural router. This design encourages concise answers on easy problems while reserving longer reasoning for harder ones, achieving improved accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across multiple reasoning benchmarks.

arXiv:2610.30351v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型经常不加区别地应用复杂的推理，导致对简单任务的思考过多，而对困难任务的思考不足。我们提出了 Route-and-Generate (Rouge)，这是一个分层训练框架，使法学硕士能够自适应地决定每个输入何时需要推理以及需要多少推理。我们的方法通过引入路由策略将推理工作量分配与答案生成分离，该路由策略在多种推理格式之间分配固定的采样预算，同时使用每个样本奖励通过 GRPO 来优化基本模型。为了促进高效推理，我们采用基于排名的奖励，有利于较短的正确解决方案，并通过提炼到神经路由器中的封闭式 KL 正则化策略改进步骤来更新路由策略。这种设计鼓励对简单问题给出简洁的答案，同时为较难的问题保留更长的推理，从而在多个推理基准上实现改进的准确性与效率权衡。

items.title: Soft Ontology Priors over Latent Concept Posteriors for Weakly Supervised Neuro-Symbolic Learning
items.titleZh: 弱监督神经符号学习的软本体先验优于潜在概念后验
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30391v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) predictors that supervise only the task label suffer from reasoning shortcuts: distinct concept mappings achieve the same maximum likelihood, leaving the recovered concepts unidentifiable and unsafe for downstream reuse. We attack this failure by injecting a soft ontology prior over the latent concepts into the training objective and compiling it together with the task constraint into a smooth, decomposable probabilistic circuit. Under independent Bernoulli perception, the normalisers of the resulting structured concept posterior reduce to weighted model counts that are linear in the compiled circuit size, because the neural leaf weights fold into the circuit before evaluation. The soft compilation strategy places expert axioms in the circuit's weights rather than its support (task-structural axioms guaranteed by the data-generating process stay hard), so noisy expert axioms only redistribute prior mass and cannot empty the support. We characterise how the prior reweights label-restricted shortcut mass through differences in ontology violation energy, show that soft priors incur bounded log-density perturbations under bounded axiom noise, and prove that the hard-support counterpart can be made degenerate by a single corrupted axiom. We validate these predictions on an audited six-concept view of the real-world BDD-OIA driving benchmark and on controlled NeSy tasks.

arXiv:2610.30391v1 公告类型：新
摘要：仅监督任务标签的神经符号（NeSy）预测器受到推理捷径的影响：不同的概念映射实现相同的最大似然，使得恢复的概念无法识别，并且对于下游重用来说不安全。我们通过将优先于潜在概念的软本体注入训练目标并将其与任务约束一起编译成平滑的、可分解的概率电路来解决这种失败。在独立伯努利感知下，所得结构化概念后验的归一化器减少为与编译电路大小呈线性关系的加权模型计数，因为神经叶权重在评估之前折叠到电路中。软编译策略将专家公理放在电路的权重而不是其支持中（数据生成过程保证的任务结构公理保持困难），因此嘈杂的专家公理只能重新分配先前的质量而不能清空支持。我们描述了先验如何通过本体违反能量的差异重新加权标签限制的捷径质量，表明软先验在有界公理噪声下会产生有界对数密度扰动，并证明硬支持对应物可以通过单个损坏的公理而退化。我们根据经过审计的现实世界 BDD-OIA 驾驶基准的六个概念视图和受控 NeSy 任务来验证这些预测。

items.title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
items.titleZh: RoleFlow：通过结构适应自我进化的多角色代理协作
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30429v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes. We propose RoleFlow, a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that refines collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis. To make structural adaptation learnable, we introduce Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization (SECPO), which evaluates each edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens. Across seven benchmarks spanning four domains, RoleFlow achieves the optimal average performance, surpassing the strongest competitor by 4.7 points. It leads on all three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points and also shows supremacy on mathematical reasoning, web interaction, and code generation. Further analyses demonstrate cross-benchmark transferability, training-data efficiency, and cross-executor generalization.

arXiv:2610.30429v1 公告类型：新
摘要：基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统通常依赖于预定义的协作结构，限制了它们对不断变化的任务需求的适应性。尽管最近的方法可以实现动态编排，但它们应用的轨迹级奖励为每个决策分配一个结果，通常很难确定单个结构变化的贡献。我们提出了 RoleFlow，这是一种自我进化的多角色代理系统，它通过反馈驱动的原子编辑和按需角色合成来完善协作结构。为了使结构适应可学习，我们引入了单编辑反事实策略优化（SECPO），它在同一链状态下对照其无编辑对应项来评估每次编辑，并将目标信用分配给特定于编辑的代币。在跨越四个领域的七个基准测试中，RoleFlow 实现了最佳平均性能，比最强的竞争对手高出 4.7 个百分点。它在所有三个多跳 QA 基准测试中领先 3.2-7.5 个 F1 点，并且在数学推理、Web 交互和代码生成方面也表现出优势。进一步的分析证明了跨基准可转移性、训练数据效率和跨执行器泛化。

items.title: Secure Agentic AI and Multimodal Intelligence in 6G Communication Systems
items.titleZh: 6G 通信系统中的安全代理人工智能和多模式智能
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30436v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Sixth-generation (6G) communication systems are expected to support immersive, intent-driven, and latency-critical services through tight integration of multimodal intelligence, edge computing, and autonomous network control. In this setting, agentic AI systems can reason over heterogeneous inputs, use tools and network functions, coordinate across distributed entities, and adapt to dynamic environments. These capabilities make agentic multimodal intelligence promising for 6G applications such as semantic communications, digital twins, and zero-touch network management, but they also introduce security and privacy risks that extend beyond conventional AI and network security models. Vulnerabilities can propagate across multimodal data pipelines, memory, tools, communication interfaces, and inter-agent coordination loops. We survey multimodal intelligence and agentic AI for 6G cross-layered communication systems from the perspectives of privacy and security. We present a 6G-oriented system view spanning perception, memory, tool use, and multi-agent orchestration; analyze threat models and attack surfaces across sensing, cognition, action, memory, and communication layers; organize existing attacks into a structured taxonomy; and review mitigation strategies including prompt and memory defenses, inter-agent trust mechanisms, secure orchestration, and privacy-preserving learning. We conclude by outlining open research directions for trustworthy multimodal multi-agent 6G systems.

arXiv:2610.30436v1 公告类型：新
摘要：第六代（6G）通信系统预计将通过多模态智能、边缘计算和自主网络控制的紧密集成来支持沉浸式、意图驱动和延迟关键型服务。在这种情况下，代理人工智能系统可以对异构输入进行推理，使用工具和网络功能，跨分布式实体进行协调，并适应动态环境。这些功能使得代理多模态智能在语义通信、数字孪生和零接触网络管理等 6G 应用中大有前景，但它们也带来了超出传统人工智能和网络安全模型范围的安全和隐私风险。漏洞可以跨多模式数据管道、内存、工具、通信接口和代理间协调循环传播。我们从隐私和安全的角度研究了 6G 跨层通信系统的多模态智能和代理人工智能。我们提出了面向 6G 的系统视图，涵盖感知、记忆、工具使用和多代理编排；分析感知、认知、行动、记忆和通信层的威胁模型和攻击面；将现有攻击组织成结构化分类法；并审查缓解策略，包括提示和记忆防御、代理间信任机制、安全编排和隐私保护学习。最后，我们概述了值得信赖的多模式多智能体 6G 系统的开放研究方向。

items.title: SpecMAGIC: Specification-Guided Multi-Task Generalization in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.titleZh: SpecMAGIC：多智能体强化学习中规范引导的多任务泛化
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30443v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multi-task generalization is an important yet underexplored problem in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Many real-world applications require multi-agent systems to generalize across complex, temporally extended tasks with diverse inter-agent coordination requirements. We introduce a specification language that combines temporal-logic task specifications with operators for expressing such requirements. We propose SpecMAGIC, a hierarchical framework that leverages the automaton structure of task specifications for subtask decomposition. A centralized high-level planner identifies and allocates compatible subtask sequences across agents, while decentralized low-level policies execute individual subtasks. This enables zero-shot generalization to new tasks by composing reusable subtask policies according to new specifications, without retraining. We establish soundness and probabilistic completeness of the high-level planner. Experiments on multi-agent navigation tasks show that SpecMAGIC substantially outperforms existing approaches on unseen task specifications and maintains strong performance as the number of agents increases.

摘要：多任务泛化是多智能体强化学习（MARL）中一个重要但尚未得到充分研究的问题。许多现实世界的应用程序需要多代理系统来概括具有不同代理间协调要求的复杂的、临时扩展的任务。我们引入了一种规范语言，它将时间逻辑任务规范与运算符结合起来以表达此类需求。我们提出了 SpecMAGIC，这是一个分层框架，利用任务规范的自动机结构进行子任务分解。集中式高级规划器识别并分配代理之间兼容的子任务序列，而分散式低级策略则执行单独的子任务。通过根据新规范构建可重用的子任务策略，无需重新训练，就可以零样本泛化到新任务。我们建立了高级规划器的健全性和概率完整性。多智能体导航任务的实验表明，SpecMAGIC 在未见过的任务规范上大大优于现有方法，并且随着智能体数量的增加保持强劲的性能。

items.title: A Three-Pillar Governance Framework for Safe and Trustworthy AI Agents
items.titleZh: 安全可信人工智能代理的三支柱治理框架
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30445v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making introduce significant challenges related to safety, alignment, accountability, and human oversight. Existing Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and responsible AI approaches provide important foundations, but many remain fragmented across system design, governance, and operational deployment. This paper presents a Three-Pillar (3P) model and framework for developing safe and trustworthy AI agents through transparency, accountability, and trustworthiness. The framework defines an evolutionary path in which increasing agent autonomy is introduced through progressive validation, structured human oversight, and auditable operational controls. We further describe how the model supports agent lifecycle monitoring, decision traceability, escalation management, and human-agent collaboration within enterprise agentic environments. By integrating oversight principles with operational mechanisms, the proposed framework provides a practical foundation for deploying AI agents that remain aligned with human intent while enabling controlled progression toward higher autonomy.

arXiv:2610.30445v1 公告类型：新
摘要：能够自主决策的人工智能代理带来了与安全、协调、问责和人类监督相关的重大挑战。现有的人在环 (HITL) 和负责任的人工智能方法提供了重要的基础，但许多方法在系统设计、治理和运营部署方面仍然支离破碎。本文提出了一个三支柱 (3P) 模型和框架，用于通过透明度、问责制和可信度来开发安全且值得信赖的人工智能代理。该框架定义了一条演进路径，通过渐进验证、结构化人工监督和可审计的操作控制来增加代理自主权。我们进一步描述该模型如何支持企业代理环境中的代理生命周期监控、决策可追溯性、升级管理和人工代理协作。通过将监督原则与操作机制相结合，所提出的框架为部署人工智能代理提供了实用的基础，这些代理与人类意图保持一致，同时实现了向更高自主权的受控进展。

items.title: Same Beliefs, Different Policies: Learning Reusable Representations for Early Stopping in LLM Reasoning
items.titleZh: 相同的信念，不同的政策：学习可重用的表示以尽早停止 LLM 推理
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30450v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reasoning LLMs often continue reasoning after reaching a correct answer, wasting computation and sometimes replacing it with an incorrect one. Deciding when to stop is a metareasoning problem: the model must weigh what further reasoning could achieve against its cost, given what it can already answer. Direct utility training learns a stopping representation at a chosen token price; supporting new prices can require additional controller training. We introduce BELT (BELief-based Termination), which separates outcome prediction from stopping control. It learns beliefs about current and future answers from a frozen LLM's hidden states, then fits a linear stopping policy on the frozen features. The prediction targets are independent of token price, so one probe supports different accuracy-cost trade-offs through CPU policy refitting or threshold adjustment. Averaged over five out-of-distribution (OOD) math benchmarks, BELT reduces generated tokens by 41% on Qwen3-1.7B and 51% on OLMo-3-7B-Think without loss of accuracy. The same math-trained BELT transfers to coding and agentic tasks without training on code or agentic data. In all three domains, its accuracy-cost trade-offs are competitive with or better than those of end-to-end controllers. On OLMo3, its probe has 21.2x fewer parameters than one checkpoint of the strongest baseline, OS-Pruner, and needs 55x fewer training GPU-hours than OS-Pruner's five price-specific checkpoints.

arXiv:2610.30450v1 公告类型：新
摘要：推理法学硕士通常在得出正确答案后继续推理，浪费计算，有时甚至用不正确的答案替换它。决定何时停止是一个元推理问题：模型必须在已经可以回答的情况下，权衡进一步推理可以实现的效果及其成本。直接效用训练以选定的代币价格学习停止表示；支持新价格可能需要额外的控制器培训。我们引入了 BELT（基于 BELief 的终止），它将结果预测与停止控制分开。它从冻结的 LLM 的隐藏状态中学习有关当前和未来答案的信念，然后在冻结的特征上拟合线性停止策略。预测目标与代币价格无关，因此一个探针可以通过 CPU 策略重新调整或阈值调整来支持不同的准确性与成本权衡。对五个分布外 (OOD) 数学基准进行平均后，BELT 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上将生成的代币减少了 41%，在 OLMo-3-7B-Think 上将生成的代币减少了 51%，而没有损失准确性。同样经过数学训练的 BELT 可以转移到编码和代理任务，而无需对代码或代理数据进行培训。在所有三个领域，其准确性与成本的权衡都与端到端控制器具有竞争力或更好。在 OLMo3 上，其探针的参数比最强基线 OS-Pruner 的一个检查点少 21.2 倍，并且比 OS-Pruner 的五个特定于价格的检查点需要的训练 GPU 小时少 55 倍。

items.title: Why Bother Me Again? Benchmarking Personal Agent Memory for Interaction Preferences
items.titleZh: 为什么又来打扰我？对交互偏好的个人代理内存进行基准测试
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30485v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Personal intelligence systems are taking on increasingly complex everyday tasks, yet repeated questions, unnecessary confirmations, and unwanted outreach can turn capable assistance into interaction burden. Reducing this burden requires agents to remember how users want to be assisted. However, existing memory benchmarks focus on factual recall and personalized answers and rarely test how agents learn and act on interaction preferences. We introduce MemPABench, an interactive environment for on-policy evaluation of memory in personal agents. MemPABench poses long-horizon tasks requiring agents to decide when to clarify, confirm, or act autonomously. Four grounded simulated users hold 14 preferences across work and personal contexts. Their feedback spans 99 sessions over four months, with five event-driven changes per user testing memory updates. We evaluate preference selection, delivered behavior, and sensitivity to context and preference change. Evaluating four memory systems across four LLM backbones, we find that current memory brings limited gains in preference selection. Retrieval-based systems (i.e. Mem0, MemOS, simple RAG) do not outperform No Memory, while File-based memory improves accuracy but applies preferences beyond relevant contexts. Our analysis shows that current memory struggles to retrieve interaction preferences and adapt to preference changes. Even with the correct preference available, overriding the agent's default interaction habits remains challenging. The environment and dataset are available at https://mempabench.com.

arXiv:2610.30485v1 公告类型：新
摘要：个人智能系统正在承担越来越复杂的日常任务，但重复的问题、不必要的确认和不必要的外展可能会将有效的帮助变成交互负担。减轻这种负担需要代理记住用户希望如何获得帮助。然而，现有的记忆基准侧重于事实回忆和个性化答案，很少测试智能体如何学习和根据交互偏好采取行动。我们引入了 MemPABench，这是一个用于对个人代理中的内存进行策略评估的交互式环境。 MemPABench 提出了长期任务，要求智能体决定何时澄清、确认或自主行动。四个接地模拟用户在工作和个人环境中拥有 14 种偏好。他们的反馈涵盖四个月内的 99 个会话，每个用户测试内存更新时有五个事件驱动的更改。我们评估偏好选择、交付行为以及对环境和偏好变化的敏感性。通过评估四个法学硕士主干的四个记忆系统，我们发现当前的记忆在偏好选择方面带来的收益有限。基于检索的系统（即 Mem0、MemOS、简单 RAG）的性能并不优于无内存，而基于文件的内存提高了准确性，但应用了超出相关上下文的首选项。我们的分析表明，当前的记忆很难检索交互偏好并适应偏好的变化。即使有正确的偏好，覆盖代理的默认交互习惯仍然具有挑战性。环境和数据集可在 https://mempabench.com 上获取。

items.title: MoEZip: Routing-Aware KV Cache Compression for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
items.titleZh: MoEZip：用于稀疏专家混合 LLM 的路由感知 KV 缓存压缩
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30206v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model capacity efficiently by activating a small subset of parameters per token. However, in long-context inference, memory remains a major bottleneck because the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce this cost for dense transformers, but overlook a problem specific to MoE: KV eviction can change which experts are selected during answer generation, degrading the generation quality. We propose MoEZip, a routing-aware KV cache compression for sparse MoE language models. To estimate the sensitivity of expert routing to perturbation, we propose a novel metric based on the Fisher information matrix of routing distributions. MoEZip combines this metric with attention weights for routing-aware scoring of contexts. Finally, we compose a complementary scoring system that combines eviction methods for dense and sparse-MoE architectures. Experiments show that MoEZip achieves robust performance under aggressive cache compression on various benchmarks. At a KV retention ratio of 10\%, MoEZip improves over the SoTA baseline by +24 and +20 points on average on LongBench and RULER, corresponding to 2.3$\times$ and 4.9$\times$ higher scores, respectively.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.30206v1 公告类型：新
摘要：专家混合（MoE）语言模型通过激活每个令牌的一小部分参数来有效地扩展模型容量。然而，在长上下文推理中，内存仍然是一个主要瓶颈，因为 KV 缓存随着序列长度线性增长。现有的 KV 缓存压缩方法降低了密集变压器的成本，但忽略了 MoE 特有的问题：KV 驱逐可能会改变在答案生成过程中选择的专家，从而降低生成质量。我们提出了 MoEZip，一种用于稀疏 MoE 语言模型的路由感知 KV 缓存压缩。为了估计专家路由对扰动的敏感性，我们提出了一种基于路由分布的 Fisher 信息矩阵的新度量。 MoEZip 将此指标与注意力权重相结合，用于上下文的路由感知评分。最后，我们构建了一个互补的评分系统，结合了密集和稀疏 MoE 架构的驱逐方法。实验表明，MoEZip 在各种基准测试中，在积极的缓存压缩下实现了稳健的性能。在 KV 保留率为 10\% 时，MoEZip 在 LongBench 和 RULER 上比 SoTA 基线平均提高了 +24 和 +20 分，分别相当于高出 2.3$\times$ 和 4.9$\times$ 分数。

items.title: Spectral Uncertainty Decomposition for Sparse Bayesian Learning
items.titleZh: 稀疏贝叶斯学习的谱不确定性分解
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30207v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Estimating distributed neural sources from M/EEG measurements is an ill-posed inverse problem where principled uncertainty quantification remains challenging. The usual conditional Gaussian posterior covariance does not explicitly distinguish uncertainty along likelihood-visible source directions from uncertainty that is invisible to the measurements. We propose a spectral framework based on the singular value structure of the prior-preconditioned forward operator, which provides an exact, interpretable decomposition of the posterior covariance into data-informed and indeterminacy epistemic components. This formulation identifies uncertainty contributions that are reducible by better measurements from those that are fundamentally irreducible by sensing geometry. We further derive an equivalent subtractive decomposition that expresses the prior covariance as the sum of posterior and data-driven reduction terms, enabling precise accounting of uncertainty reduction through Bayesian learning. Together, these complementary representations offer both theoretical insight and practical tools for interpretable uncertainty quantification in M/EEG source imaging for linear-Gaussian Bayesian inverse solvers where the posterior covariance is available in closed form.

arXiv:2610.30207v1 公告类型：新
摘要：从 M/EEG 测量估计分布式神经源是一个不适定的逆问题，原则上的不确定性量化仍然具有挑战性。通常的条件高斯后验协方差没有明确区分沿似然可见源方向的不确定性和测量不可见的不确定性。我们提出了一个基于先验预处理前向算子的奇异值结构的谱框架，它提供了后验协方差到数据通知和不确定性认知组件的精确、可解释的分解。该公式确定了可以通过更好的测量来减少的不确定性贡献，而这些不确定性贡献基本上不能通过传感几何来减少。我们进一步推导了等效的减法分解，将先验协方差表示为后验和数据驱动的减少项之和，从而能够通过贝叶斯学习精确计算不确定性减少。总之，这些互补的表示为线性高斯贝叶斯逆求解器的 M/EEG 源成像中可解释的不确定性量化提供了理论见解和实用工具，其中后验协方差以封闭形式提供。

items.title: Prediction Is Not Calibration: Item Parameter Recovery and Representation Coupling in Knowledge Tracing
items.titleZh: 预测不是校准：知识追踪中的项目参数恢复和表示耦合
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30211v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Knowledge tracing (KT) models can estimate item parameters through an item response decoder trained solely for next-response prediction, yet predictive accuracy does not guarantee parameter recovery. We study 2PL, GPCM, and NRM decoders paired with LSTM, Transformer, and DKVMN encoders. Response-model derivatives show why discrimination and option slope updates depend directly on the scale and spread of estimated ability. Affine logit identities show how item-dependent shifts and rescaling in estimated ability are absorbed into item parameters without changing response probabilities. In simulations, difficulty, mean threshold, and correct-option intercept recovery remain high under shuffled order across representation widths, whereas discrimination and keyed option slope contrast recovery require wider item representations and degrade further under fixed item order. Separating the sequence item representation (width $d_S$) from the item parameter key (width $d_M$), and pairing a wide key with a thin sequence representation ($\mathrm{SK}(64,8)$), reduces fixed-order ability distortions and improves recovery and cross-order consistency without sacrificing test accuracy or increasing model size relative to a shared width-64 baseline ($\mathrm{SH}(64)$). On TIMSS and EdNet, widening $d_M$ consistently improves agreement with an offline IRT reference, while the trade-off from narrowing $d_S$ depends on the encoder's reliance on sequence width for prediction. These findings show why item parameters, especially discrimination and option slopes, must be evaluated separately from response prediction.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.30211v1 公告类型：新
摘要：知识追踪（KT）模型可以通过专门为下一个响应预测训练的项目响应解码器来估计项目参数，但预测准确性并不能保证参数恢复。我们研究与 LSTM、Transformer 和 DKVMN 编码器配对的 2PL、GPCM 和 NRM 解码器。响应模型导数表明为什么歧视和选项斜率更新直接取决于估计能力的规模和分布。仿射 logit 恒等式显示了项目相关的偏移和估计能力的重新调整如何被吸收到项目参数中而不改变响应概率。在模拟中，在跨表示宽度的洗牌顺序下，难度、平均阈值和正确选项截距恢复仍然很高，而辨别和键控选项斜率对比度恢复需要更宽的项目表示，并且在固定项目顺序下进一步退化。将序列项表示（宽度 $d_S$）与项参数键（宽度 $d_M$）分开，并将宽键与细序列表示（$\mathrm{SK}(64,8)$）配对，可以减少固定顺序能力扭曲并提高恢复和跨顺序一致性，而不会牺牲测试精度或相对于共享宽度 64 基线（$\mathrm{SH}(64)$）增加模型大小。在 TIMSS 和 EdNet 上，加宽 $d_M$ 始终可以提高与离线 IRT 参考的一致性，而缩小 $d_S$ 的权衡取决于编码器对预测序列宽度的依赖。这些发现说明了为什么项目参数，特别是歧视和选项斜率，必须与响应预测分开评估。

items.title: AI Mindmeld: A Latent Interconnect Protocol
items.titleZh: AI Mindmeld：潜在互连协议
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30215v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: LLMs can act as scientific agents using tools to consult specialists and run experiments. Yet specialist information must enter their context, generally as text, images, audio or video: a bottleneck between models with rich, high-dimensional representations. We advocate direct representation exchange: a mindmeld conveying many properties, including information an LLM would not think to request. It should be extensible to new specialists, flexible across questions and tasks, and compositional across independently connected specialists without joint training.
 The Latent Interconnect Protocol (LIP) learns connectors mapping specialist representations into LLM internal states. Training only connectors keeps this practical as LLMs grow and evolve. We connect three protein and three small molecule specialists to Gemma 3 (4B and 12B parameters) and Kimi K2.6 (1T total, 32B active), freezing all pretrained models. Independently trained connectors provide useful information without changing the LLM or existing connectors, supporting familiar and new question types about unseen objects. We demonstrate zero-shot transfer to cross-domain tasks without joint training. Task performance and compositionality generally improve with LLM capability, with especially strong gains in zero-shot task transfer. Limitations remain: current LLMs were not trained for specialist representations as native inputs; access does not ensure reliable interpretation, integration or use in reasoning. We call on specialist developers to provide consistent representation interfaces and, especially, on LLM developers to train models to receive, combine and reason with these inputs. These efforts could expand scientific agents' information while preserving conventional tools' flexibility.
 Data, pretrained connectors, and code for training, evaluation and interactive inference: https://github.com/PolymathicAI/AI-Mindmeld

arXiv:2610.30215v1 公告类型：新
摘要：法学硕士可以充当科学代理人，使用工具咨询专家和进行实验。然而，专业信息必须进入其上下文，通常以文本、图像、音频或视频的形式：具有丰富、高维表示的模型之间的瓶颈。我们提倡直接表示交换：心灵融合传达许多属性，包括法学硕士不会要求的信息。它应该可以扩展到新的专家，灵活地处理问题和任务，并且可以在独立连接的专家之间进行组合，而无需联合培训。
 潜在互连协议 (LIP) 学习将专业表示映射到 LLM 内部状态的连接器。随着法学硕士的成长和发展，仅对连接器进行培训就可以保持这一实用性。我们将三个蛋白质和三个小分子专家连接到 Gemma 3（4B 和 12B 参数）和 Kimi K2.6（总计 1T，32B 活跃），冻结所有预训练模型。独立训练的连接器提供有用的信息，无需更改法学硕士或现有连接器，支持有关未见物体的熟悉和新问题类型。我们演示了无需联合训练即可实现跨域任务的零样本迁移。任务性能和组合性通常会随着 LLM 能力的提高而提高，尤其是在零样本任务迁移方面取得了显着的进步。局限性仍然存在：目前的法学硕士没有接受过专业代表作为本地投入的培训；访问并不能确保推理中的可靠解释、整合或使用。我们呼吁专业开发人员提供一致的表示接口，特别是法学硕士开发人员训练模型以接收、组合和推理这些输入。这些努力可以扩大科学人员的信息，同时保留传统工具的灵活性。

items.title: When Reconstruction Is Not Enough: Doubly Robust Counterfactual and Interventional Mediation Analysis with Learned Multimodal Representations
items.titleZh: 当重建还不够时：具有学习多模态表示的双重稳健反事实和干预中介分析
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30220v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Learned representations of high-dimensional multimodal health records are increasingly used to adjust for confounding, yet they are usually trained to reconstruct the data rather than preserve the information that causal identification requires. We study counterfactual outcomes under alternative treatments, including phenotype-specific effects and patient-level counterfactual risk profiles of the kind digital twins provide, and interventional direct and indirect effects under exposure-induced intermediate confounding. We give conditions under which a representation preserves identification and show that interventional mediation is more demanding than counterfactual comparison. We prove that no covariate-only training objective, whether reconstruction, contrastive, or physics-informed, can certify that a representation is sufficient, and that, in a linear structural model, a representation can lose arbitrarily little reconstruction accuracy yet induce arbitrarily large bias. We decompose the error of cross-fitted doubly robust estimators into a first-order representation bias, which neither double robustness nor cross-fitting removes, and a second-order remainder of nuisance-estimation errors, so coverage worsens as the sample size grows when the representation is insufficient. We propose a workflow combining modality-specific variational autoencoders trained outside the estimation sample, cross-fitted doubly robust estimators, locked phenotypes, select-then-confirm pathway analysis, portable representations, and diagnostics for representation insufficiency, exposure leakage, and sensitivity. In simulations, discarding a rare, moderately strong confounder gave indirect-effect intervals with 2% coverage at n = 3,000; reconstruction loss missed the problem, and a simple predictive diagnostic flagged it in every replicate.

摘要：高维多模式健康记录的学习表示越来越多地用于调整混杂因素，但它们通常被训练来重建数据，而不是保存因果识别所需的信息。我们研究替代治疗下的反事实结果，包括数字双胞胎提供的表型特异性效应和患者水平的反事实风险概况，以及暴露引起的中间混杂因素下的干预直接和间接效应。我们给出了表征保留认同的条件，并表明干预调解比反事实比较要求更高。我们证明，只有协变量的训练目标，无论是重建、对比还是物理信息，都不能证明表示是足够的，并且在线性结构模型中，表示可能会损失任意小的重建精度，但会引起任意大的偏差。我们将交叉拟合的双鲁棒估计量的误差分解为一阶表示偏差（双鲁棒性和交叉拟合都无法消除）和二阶剩余的讨厌估计误差，因此当表示不足时，随着样本量的增加，覆盖率会恶化。我们提出了一个工作流程，结合了在估计样本之外训练的特定模态变分自动编码器、交叉拟合的双鲁棒估计器、锁定表型、选择然后确认路径分析、可移植表示以及表示不足、暴露泄漏和灵敏度的诊断。在模拟中，丢弃罕见的、中等强度的混杂因素，在 n = 3,000 时给出覆盖率为 2% 的间接效应区间；重建损失错过了这个问题，并且一个简单的预测诊断在每个重复中都标记了它。

items.title: How Prompt Style Affects AI Accuracy and Speed in Competitive Programming
items.titleZh: 竞争性编程中提示风格如何影响人工智能的准确性和速度
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30223v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in competitive programming, and their outputs are sensitive to how a prompt is phrased. Prior work has compared prompt strategies for accuracy on competitive programming, but not for runtime speed, and has not situated the results against human performance. In an exploratory study of one prompt in each of nine styles on GPT-5.5 across three accuracy tasks from the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) and two NP-hard speed tasks, we found that no single prompt was best: the strongest prompt depended on the task type and on whether results were summarized by the mean or the median, suggesting that, at least for these tasks, prompt style should be matched to the objective rather than treated as universal. Many differences in mean scores came from a few outlier runs, showing that evaluating prompting by a single metric can obscure how much its effectiveness varies. Compared descriptively with human IOI contestants, who worked under different conditions, the AI was neither strictly better nor strictly worse, exceeding the average contestant on one task but falling short on the other two. By extending prompt comparison from accuracy to runtime speed and grounding it against human performance, this study gives a broader picture of how prompt style affects competitive programming performance.

摘要：大型语言模型越来越多地用于竞争性编程，其输出对提示的措辞非常敏感。之前的工作比较了竞争性编程准确性的即时策略，但没有比较运行速度，并且没有将结果与人类表现进行比较。在一项对 GPT-5.5 上的九种提示风格的探索性研究中，涉及国际信息学奥林匹克 (IOI) 的三项准确性任务和两项 NP-hard 速度任务，我们发现没有一种提示是最好的：最强的提示取决于任务类型以及结果是按平均值还是中位数总结，这表明，至少对于这些任务，提示风格应与目标相匹配，而不是被视为通用。平均分数的许多差异来自一些异常值运行，这表明通过单个指标评估提示可能会掩盖其有效性的差异。与在不同条件下工作的人类 IOI 参赛者相比，人工智能既没有严格意义上的更好，也没有严格意义上的更差，在一项任务上超过了平均参赛者，但在其他两项上却落后了。通过将提示比较从准确性扩展到运行时间速度，并将其与人类表现进行比较，本研究更全面地了解了提示风格如何影响竞争性编程性能。

items.title: GANet: A Lightweight Group Attention Network for Plant Disease Identification on Embedded Systems
items.titleZh: GANet：用于嵌入式系统上植物病害识别的轻量级群体注意力网络
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30225v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Global warming and climate change are major catalysts for plant diseases, significantly affecting food production worldwide. Addressing this issue requires continuous monitoring and early detection of plant diseases. While recent advancements in deep learning offer potential solutions, most models demand high processing power and struggle to perform efficiently on low-end electronic hardware. Furthermore, many existing works focus on specific crop diseases, limiting their broader applicability. This paper presents a lightweight Group Equivariance Attention Network (GANet) designed for the prediction and monitoring of 38 types of plant diseases. GANet introduces a novel Group Attention block and Group-Wise Feature Fusion block, making it both sparse and efficient. With only 0.001M parameters, the model achieves an impressive 99.99% accuracy on the PlantVillage dataset. Additionally, GANet is optimized for deployment on edge devices such as the Raspberry Pi 4b and Jetson Nano, where it reaches 5 FPS and 11 FPS, respectively, demonstrating its potential for real-time plant disease monitoring on low-power devices.

items.title: Benchmarking Model Compression Techniques Across Heterogeneous Edge Platforms: A Predictive Maintenance Use Case for Rotating Machinery
items.titleZh: 跨异构边缘平台的模型压缩技术基准测试：旋转机械的预测性维护用例
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30228v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: To enable Industry 5.0, where autonomous systems are widely adopted and integrated with people to promote sustainable development in industries, it is imperative to adapt complex deep learning models to operate efficiently on resource-constrained hardware for edge inference. However, adapting these models remains challenging due to the hardware heterogeneity of edge computing in industrial settings, performance degradation caused by model compression, and the lack of clear guidance on which compression techniques are practical and effective for applications such as predictive maintenance. To address these challenges, this paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of four state-of-the-art model compression techniques applied to a high-performance convolutional neural network for predictive maintenance using a real-world dataset of rotating machinery, equipment typically used in industry. The compressed models were evaluated across a heterogeneous set of nine computing platforms, ranging from highly constrained edge computing devices to general purpose and high-performance processors, reflecting the diversity and fragmentation typical of industrial edge environments. By jointly prioritizing classification performance, inference speed, and compression ratio, we found that compression using knowledge distillation emerged as the most effective approach. The model had more than 90% speedup across all devices while maintaining a 91.22% balanced F-score, with a very small drop in predictive performance relative to the uncompressed model, along with a 98.9% size reduction. Through successful deployment across multiple edge platforms and a systematic comparison of compression strategies, we demonstrated a clear path to achieving Industry 5.0 targets, drastically cutting computational costs and, consequently, energy consumption without sacrificing predictive performance.

items.title: Automated screening of privacy risks in medical AI
items.titleZh: 医疗AI隐私风险自动筛查
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30229v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Medical artificial intelligence (AI) models are often shared without their training data, assuming this protects the patients who contributed them. However, a model can reveal whether a patient's records were used in training, a privacy breach known as a membership inference attack. This risk is usually reported as a cohort average, which can appear negligible while individual patients are almost certainly exposed. Identifying potentially vulnerable records before developing a production model could make privacy assessment more practical. We measured each patient's vulnerability to membership inference attack, across 7,789 models trained on six clinical datasets in four modalities, including two adapted pretrained medical models. Training choices changed how many patients had high attack scores, but the patients who ranked highest by risk largely stayed the same across the configurations we tested. Stronger weight decay reduced the exposed cohort up to threefold, yet largely the same patients remained most at risk across training recipes, architectures and initializations, including foundation models. Therefore, we developed a lightweight screening tool that uses four small models to identify patients with high risk of exposure before production-model training. We also assessed if flagged patients could be protected without removing their data. Privacy screening should become incorporated into data preparation for clinical AI.

items.title: Edit, Don't Imitate: Minimal-Edit On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
items.titleZh: 编辑，不要模仿：多模态推理的最小编辑按策略蒸馏
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30231v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Visual mathematical reasoning can fail before reasoning begins: when a vision-language model (VLM) misreads a diagram, subsequent reasoning proceeds from false premises. This perceptual bottleneck is especially pronounced in smaller models, while accurate textual descriptions can substantially narrow the gap to larger models. Because obtaining such descriptions at inference requires additional annotation or model calls, we propose minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation. Using reference figure descriptions and verified reference solutions as training-only information, a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective, and only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss. Correct rollouts receive task-reward reinforcement learning. This preserves on-policy supervision while avoiding full-response imitation. Across model scales, the method requires no descriptions at test time and meets or exceeds the corresponding base model supplied with a reference figure description at inference. It also improves perception-oriented performance, particularly low-level geometric perception, and transfers to external mathematics and perception benchmarks. Because the minimal-edit teacher evaluates corrections rather than generating its own solution, the method remains effective with a frozen same-size teacher, although its gains are smaller than with a larger teacher on most metrics.

arXiv:2610.30231v1 公告类型：新
摘要：视觉数学推理可能会在推理开始之前失败：当视觉语言模型（VLM）误读图表时，后续推理会从错误的前提出发。这种感知瓶颈在较小的模型中尤其明显，而准确的文本描述可以大大缩小与较大模型的差距。由于在推理时获得此类描述需要额外的注释或模型调用，因此我们提出最小编辑校正策略蒸馏。使用参考图描述和经过验证的参考解决方案作为仅训练信息，教师可以在最小编辑目标下对不正确的学生展示进行评分，并且只有教师不喜欢的标记才会导致纠正损失。正确的部署会收到任务奖励强化学习。这保留了政策监督，同时避免了全响应模仿。在模型尺度上，该方法在测试时不需要描述，并且满足或超过在推理时提供参考图描述的相应基础模型。它还提高了面向感知的性能，特别是低级几何感知，并转移到外部数学和感知基准。由于最小编辑教师评估修正而不是生成自己的解决方案，因此该方法对于冻结的相同规模的教师仍然有效，尽管在大多数指标上其收益小于较大的教师。

items.title: A Quadratic Lens on Muon's Polar Update: Benefits, Pitfalls, and the Role of Newton-Schulz
items.titleZh: Muon 极地更新的二次透镜：好处、陷阱和牛顿-舒尔茨的作用
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30280v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Muon updates matrix-valued parameters along approximately orthogonalized directions and often trains large language models faster than AdamW, yet it remains unclear when and why orthogonalization helps. We study PolarGD, the orthogonalized update at the core of Muon, on matrix quadratics, where optimizers can be analyzed in closed form, and compare update directions under line search to remove the effect of learning-rate tuning. Orthogonalization pays off when the gradient is far from low rank and its largest singular directions see high curvature. PolarGD reaches the minimizer in one step whenever the rows of the error are orthogonal with equal norms, for any Hessian, whereas gradient descent needs all Hessian eigenvalues to be equal; and unlike sign descent, PolarGD is unaffected by rotations of the problem. Over many steps, PolarGD acts as gradient descent preconditioned by the current iterate, so its speed is governed by the conditioning of the iterate rather than of the Hessian. This explains fast regimes as well as a slow one, caused by tiny singular values of the iterate, in which PolarGD is much slower than gradient descent. Finally, the few Newton-Schulz iterations used in Muon treat these tiny singular values as gradient descent does, so fewer iterations can converge faster than exact orthogonalization; in a transformer trained with Muon, about a quarter of the singular values of the attention matrices fall in this regime.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.30280v1 公告类型：新
摘要：Muon 沿着近似正交的方向更新矩阵值参数，并且通常比 AdamW 更快地训练大型语言模型，但目前尚不清楚正交化何时以及为何有帮助。我们研究了 PolarGD，即 Muon 核心的正交更新，在矩阵二次方程上，其中优化器可以以封闭形式进行分析，并比较线搜索下的更新方向，以消除学习率调整的影响。当梯度远离低阶并且其最大奇异方向出现高曲率时，正交化会得到回报。对于任何 Hessian 矩阵，只要误差行与相同范数正交，PolarGD 一步即可达到最小化，而梯度下降则需要所有 Hessian 特征值相等；与符号下降不同，PolarGD 不受问题旋转的影响。在许多步骤中，PolarGD 充当由当前迭代进行预处理的梯度下降，因此其速度由迭代的条件而不是 Hessian 的条件决定。这解释了由迭代的微小奇异值引起的快速状态和慢速状态，其中 PolarGD 比梯度下降慢得多。最后，Muon 中使用的少数牛顿-舒尔茨迭代将这些微小的奇异值视为梯度下降，因此更少的迭代可以比精确正交化更快地收敛；在用 Muon 训练的 Transformer 中，注意力矩阵的奇异值大约有四分之一落在这个范围内。

items.title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
items.titleZh: SWE-VERIFIER：经济高效的编码代理的选择性验证
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30284v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories. Poor action choices can steer agents into low-value states, wasting computation and increasing API costs. Sampling and verifying alternative actions can improve the agent's decisions, but applying this procedure at every step adds substantial overhead. We introduce SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification. It scores the coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. We train SWE-Verifier from Qwen3.5-4B using preference data that groups contrasting actions with their resulting environment observations and rubric-guided teacher scores. Using the mini-swe-agent harness, SWE-Verifier improves resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% on MiniMax-M2.7 at 1.09 times cost and generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, improving resolution from 72.60% to 74.27% at 1.13 times cost. Across both models, SWE-Verifier verifies fewer than 4% of steps and achieves comparable or higher resolution than the trajectory and all-step baselines at substantially lower cost. These results demonstrate that selective candidate sampling and lightweight verification provide complementary gains in coding-agent performance and inference efficiency. Our model, code, and data are available at https://github.com/zkjzou/SWE-Verifier.

arXiv:2610.30284v1 公告类型：新
摘要：编码代理花费大量计算来生成动作并处理长交互历史。糟糕的操作选择可能会引导代理进入低价值状态，浪费计算并增加 API 成本。对替代操作进行采样和验证可以改善代理的决策，但在每个步骤中应用此过程会增加大量开销。我们引入了 SWE-Verifier，这是一种轻量级生成模型，可以选择性地触发候选采样和验证。它对编码代理建议的操作进行评分，以确定何时需要额外的候选采样，然后在执行之前对结果操作进行排名。我们使用偏好数据从 Qwen3.5-4B 训练 SWE-Verifier，这些偏好数据将对比行为与其结果环境观察和评分标准引导的教师分数进行分组。使用 mini-swe-agent 工具，SWE-Verifier 以 1.09 倍的成本将 MiniMax-M2.7 上的分辨率从 75.47% 提高到 77.20%，并在没有对其动作进行训练的情况下推广到 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，以 1.13 倍的成本将分辨率从 72.60% 提高到 74.27%。在这两种模型中，SWE-Verifier 验证了不到 4% 的步骤，并以低得多的成本实现了与轨迹和全步骤基线相当或更高的分辨率。这些结果表明，选择性候选采样和轻量级验证在编码代理性能和推理效率方面提供了互补的增益。我们的模型、代码和数据可在 https://github.com/zkjzou/SWE-Verifier 获取。

items.title: Generalizing Metropolis-Hastings for DAG Sampling
items.titleZh: 推广 Metropolis-Hastings 进行 DAG 采样
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30291v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: A fundamental challenge in Bayesian network structure learning lies in efficiently approximating the posterior distribution of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). For large, high-dimensional datasets, the task remains beyond the capabilities of current methods. This work advances Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms by introducing novel moves that simultaneously resample the parents for multiple nodes of the DAG. At the core of these moves is duet sampling, a new generalization of the Metropolis-Hastings algorithm that selects two proposal distributions from a pool at each iteration. One is used for generating a candidate state of the Markov chain and another for evaluating the return to the current state; both are ingredients of an appropriately crafted acceptance criterion. Pairing different proposal distributions provides additional freedom and enables constructing Markov chains that mix more efficiently than their basic Metropolis-Hastings counterparts, at no additional computational cost. Experiments show that our new moves, both individually and in combination, outperform the previous state of the art, which relies on a more restrictive pool of moves. This advantage persists even when letting the previous methods leverage duet sampling to enhance their performance.

arXiv:2610.30291v1 公告类型：新
摘要：贝叶斯网络结构学习的一个基本挑战在于有效逼近有向无环图（DAG）的后验分布。对于大型高维数据集，该任务仍然超出了当前方法的能力。这项工作通过引入同时对 DAG 多个节点的父节点进行重新采样的新颖举措来推进马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗算法。这些举措的核心是二重采样，这是 Metropolis-Hastings 算法的新推广，该算法在每次迭代时从池中选择两个提案分布。一个用于生成马尔可夫链的候选状态，另一个用于评估返回当前状态；两者都是适当制定的验收标准的组成部分。配对不同的提议分布提供了额外的自由度，并且能够构建比基本 Metropolis-Hastings 对应物更有效混合的马尔可夫链，而无需额外的计算成本。实验表明，我们的新动作，无论是单独还是组合，都优于以前的技术水平，后者依赖于更严格的动作池。即使让以前的方法利用二重采样来增强其性能，这种优势仍然存在。

items.title: GAV: A scientific experimentation environment for PDE agents
items.titleZh: GAV：PDE 试剂的科学实验环境
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30292v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reliable feedback is essential for coding agents to develop programs for partial differential equations (PDEs). Yet evaluating these programs on new PDE problems often requires expensive reference computations, while fixed datasets restrict the range of experiments. We introduce Generator-Agent-Verifier (GAV), a scientific experimentation environment that makes new PDE problems verifiable by construction. The Generator learns a distribution of continuous reference solutions using data from numerical simulations or experimental measurements to represent a target physical regime. Using the method of manufactured solutions, it works backward from the generated reference solutions to construct matching PDE problems without a separate numerical solve. The Agent designs experiments, investigates failures, and iteratively improves its program. The Verifier evaluates candidate programs against the reference solutions and provides numerical feedback on accuracy and computational cost. This feedback can also guide the generation of new problems that probe the current program's weaknesses. We provide a theoretical analysis of evaluation reliability and guided development. Experiments on Navier-Stokes and Vlasov-Poisson-type equations across different data sources and regimes demonstrate the effectiveness of GAV. In particular, on the numerical Navier-Stokes task, GAV reduces the mean test error of three existing PDE agents by more than an order of magnitude relative to their original setups. Code is available at https://github.com/PotatoJnny/PDE-GAV.

摘要：可靠的反馈对于编码代理开发偏微分方程（PDE）程序至关重要。然而，在新的偏微分方程问题上评估这些程序通常需要昂贵的参考计算，而固定数据集限制了实验范围。我们引入了生成器-代理-验证器 (GAV)，这是一种科学实验环境，可以通过构建验证新的偏微分方程问题。生成器使用数值模拟或实验测量中的数据来学习连续参考解的分布，以表示目标物理状态。使用制造解决方案的方法，它从生成的参考解决方案向后工作，以构造匹配的偏微分方程问题，而无需单独的数值求解。代理设计实验、调查故障并迭代改进其程序。验证器根据参考解决方案评估候选程序，并提供有关准确性和计算成本的数值反馈。这种反馈还可以指导新问题的产生，以探究当前程序的弱点。我们提供评估可靠性的理论分析和指导开发。在不同数据源和制度下对 Navier-Stokes 和 Vlasov-Poisson 型方程进行的实验证明了 GAV 的有效性。特别是，在数值 Navier-Stokes 任务中，GAV 将三个现有 PDE 代理的平均测试误差相对于其原始设置降低了一个数量级以上。代码可在 https://github.com/PotatoJnny/PDE-GAV 获取。

items.title: Spike-Aware Gradient-Based Mixed-Precision Quantization of Spiking Neural Networks for Vision Applications
items.titleZh: 用于视觉应用的尖峰神经网络的基于尖峰感知梯度的混合精度量化
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.30339v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: In recent years, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have gained massive attention as an energy-efficient neural computing paradigm due to their event-driven and sparse computing capability. However, maintaining accuracy under low-precision constraints, necessary for practical deployment, has been largely unexplored for SNN models. In addition, existing Hessian-based approaches for quantization, such as HAWQ-V2, incur significant memory and computational overhead due to temporal unrolling across multiple SNN timesteps. We propose a spike-aware gradient-based mixed-precision quantization framework for SNNs that adaptively assigns bit-widths using first-order gradient information, avoiding costly second-order Hessian computations. We evaluate our method across various SNN-based architectures, including VGG, ResNet, and Vision Transformer models obtained from both ANN-to-SNN conversion and direct training frameworks, on CIFAR10/100, ImageNet, and DVS-CIFAR-10 datasets. Notably, on ResNet-34 evaluated on ImageNet, our method achieves 73.30% accuracy at 4.78$\times$ compression, which is comparable to that provided by HAWQ-V2, while reducing memory consumption by 2.31$\times$ and bit-allocation runtime by 100$\times$. We also present an energy analysis for mixed-precision SNNs showing that the proposed quantization strategy enables energy-efficient deployment without compromising performance.

arXiv:2610.30339v1 公告类型：新
摘要：近年来，尖峰神经网络（SNN）由于其事件驱动和稀疏计算能力，作为一种节能的神经计算范式而受到广泛关注。然而，SNN 模型在很大程度上尚未探索实际部署所需的在低精度约束下保持精度的问题。此外，现有的基于 Hessian 的量化方法（例如 HAWQ-V2）由于跨多个 SNN 时间步的时间展开而会产生大量内存和计算开销。我们为 SNN 提出了一种基于尖峰感知梯度的混合精度量化框架，该框架使用一阶梯度信息自适应地分配位宽，避免昂贵的二阶 Hessian 计算。我们在 CIFAR10/100、ImageNet 和 DVS-CIFAR-10 数据集上跨各种基于 SNN 的架构（包括从 ANN 到 SNN 转换和直接训练框架获得的 VGG、ResNet 和 Vision Transformer 模型）评估我们的方法。值得注意的是，在 ImageNet 上评估的 ResNet-34 上，我们的方法以 4.78$\times$ 压缩率实现了 73.30% 的准确率，与 HAWQ-V2 提供的精度相当，同时将内存消耗减少了 2.31$\times$，并将位分配运行时间减少了 100$\times$。我们还提出了混合精度 SNN 的能量分析，表明所提出的量化策略可以在不影响性能的情况下实现节能部署。
